description:
Create a new item and try to link it into goggles (glasses) slot.
{{Feature | informative | This command does '''not''' add NVGs, which are [[hmd]] slot items (see [[linkItem]] instead). The glasses could be one of the following modes:

<sqf>_mode = getNumber(configFile >> "CfgGlasses" >> "G_Diving" >> "mode"); // 1 
/*
0 - None
1 - Diving
2 - Goggles
3 - NVG
4 - DivingAndOverwater (since 2.08)
*/
</sqf>
}}
name: addGoggles
